The structure of Yb8Si16 (reduced formula Yb2Si4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Si centers with 9 geometric neighbors (4 Si, 5 Yb; distances 2.6747–3.1961 Å), while Yb centers have 12 neighbors (9 Si, 3 Yb; 2.8049–3.1961 Å), with one Si and two Yb orbits per cell. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among 9-vertex Si polyhedra and corner/face sharing between 9-vertex Si and 12-vertex Yb polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component.
